result.topic_en: Faint pencil calculation of the variation of a volume integral involving 1/r, derivatives of u with respect to x and a, and terms (x-a), rewritten as a sum of divergence (partial x-derivative) terms.
result.transcription:
$\int \Delta[?] \frac{1}{r^3} \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}(x-a) \cdots\right) \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial a}(x-a) \cdots\right) [-\partial-] \delta \frac{1}{r} \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\frac{\partial u}{\partial a} \cdots\right) dx\,dy\,dz$
$dx\,dy\,dz$[?]
$= \int \Big( - \frac{\partial}{\partial x}\left(\delta \frac{1}{r} \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial a}(x-a) \cdots\right)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\right) \cdots$
$- \frac{\partial}{\partial x}\left(\frac{1}{r}\frac{\partial u}{\partial a}\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\delta a \cdots\right)\right) \cdots$
$+ \frac{\partial}{\partial x}\left(\frac{1}{r}\delta a \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial a}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} \cdots\right)\right)\Big) \cdots$

methods.what: Rewriting the variation of a volume integral as a sum of total x-derivatives (divergence terms), i.e. integration by parts
